business_problem: Puma Energy needed a better way to support global fuel stockout prediction, safety reporting, and customer analytics because fragmented regional systems and slow refresh cycles meant frontline teams waited hours for insights and could not prevent fuel disruptions fast enough.
solution_summary: Puma Energy uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support global fuel stockout prediction, safety reporting, and customer analytics. The implementation replaced a legacy state where fragmented regional systems and slow refresh cycles meant frontline teams waited hours for insights and could not prevent fuel disruptions fast enough. Global fuel operations data and inventory levels move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Model Serving operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver predictive stockout alerts and safety audit reports.
business_outcome: Puma Energy improved global fuel stockout prediction, safety reporting, and customer analytics with measurable results including 98-99% modernizing fuel access in underserved communities, Decrease in data latency, going from 4–5 hours to under 5 minutes, and 20%+, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
